guardrails: none: no citation gate, no critic, fix not forced to need approval
rationale: currencyservice has the largest anomaly (latency-50 z=+403) and its memory rose from 4.49e7 to 2.02e8 (+349%, z=+69.8), while frontend and checkout latency rises follow it and the slowest traces all pass through currencyservice. Logs contain no errors or warnings, and the socket increase (3 to ~6) and small CPU rise (+30.6%) are weaker, so mem is the best-supported fault but not certain.

proposed_fix.description: Restart or roll currencyservice pods to release memory as a mitigation, then inspect for a memory leak and set appropriate memory limits.
